_note: Rules the boards left open, decided for the build.

unlocks.sector: Sector n opens when stage 10 of sector n-1 is first cleared (same as stage unlock rule); sector 1 always open
unlocks.stage: Stage n unlocks when stage n-1 is cleared (first stage always open)
unlocks.viper_lance: unlocks on first clear of stage 2
unlocks.titan_bulwark: unlocks on first clear of stage 3

credits_per_star.rule: 1 star = round(10*m), 2 stars = round(20*m), 3 stars = round(30*m); only the stars newly earned beyond previous best pay

keys_solo: Solo accepts both WASD and arrows for move; Special = L SHIFT or R SHIFT; Bomb = B or R CTRL; Pause ESC
exit_button: Shows a confirm dialog from the Confirms board; on yes calls window.close(); if the browser blocks it, stay on Home
controls_remap: Settings 'VIEW & REMAP CONTROLS' opens a read-only view of the Controls board in v1 (no remap)

coop.profile_pick: After mode select, Player 1 then Player 2 pick a profile on the Profiles screen; each earns own credits and first-clear status
coop.manual_fire: Manual fire setting applies to both pilots

delete_profile: Delete shows the Confirms board dialog; yes removes the profile and its slots
tooling: Do not install electron or capacitor yet (remove from package.json until step 11). Use installed Google Chrome for Playwright if Smart App Control blocks Chromium.
reference_pngs: All reference/screens PNGs were re-captured with Orbitron and Exo 2 loaded; text in them is now final.
naming: SECTOR = 10 stages (10 sectors). STAGE = one level with one boss (or pair). Stage theme = environment (Ember Belt, Venom Nebula ...). Boards were updated to this; copy board text exactly
music_for_stages: Stage uses music track ((theme_ref-1) mod 4)+1 of the four stage tracks (Ember Belt, Venom Nebula, Iron Fleet, Void Rift); Boss Theme during the boss
